description: Plans secure SDK and CLI publishing to npm, PyPI, Maven Central (Java, Kotlin, Scala), NuGet (.NET), Go, crates.io, pub.dev (Dart, Flutter), RubyGems, Packagist, Hex, SwiftPM, CocoaPods, React Native and Docker Hub, plus private feeds (Artifactory). Covers trusted publishing (OIDC), CI auto-publishing, provenance, library vs binary releases (GoReleaser, cargo-dist, cibuildwheel), rollback and dependency-confusion defense. Use whenever the user mentions npm publish, NPM_TOKEN, NuGet API keys, cargo publish, gem push, pod trunk, a release pipeline or private packages in CI. Not for app stores, extension marketplaces or service deploys. Do NOT use for MCP registry listing - use samber/developer-platform-skills@mcp-server-offering; or SDK language choice - use samber/developer-platform-skills@sdk-portfolio-strategy.
